title: Tutor Learner Awareness
description: Equip the EthioBio tutor pipeline with per-learner awareness: a LearnerProfileBuilder converts a LearnerSnapshot into a structured profile block, AdaptiveStrategySelector picks a teaching strategy, and TutorContextAdapter bundles everything into a formatted system prompt extension.

userStories.title: TutorNode integrates learner profile block into system prompt
TutorContextPackage dataclass
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a TutorContextPackage dataclass that bundles LearnerSnapshot, profile_block, difficulty_level, known_misconceptions, top_recommendations, selected_strategy, and formatted_block into one object.
acceptanceCriteria: TutorContextPackage is a frozen dataclass with all 7 fields

userStories.title: AdaptiveStrategySelector: strategy selection from learner state
userStories.description: As a developer, I want AdaptiveStrategySelector that picks a teaching strategy (MISCONCEPTION_REMEDIATION, CONFIDENCE_BUILDING, RECOVERY_SUPPORT, EXAM_PREPARATION, DIRECT_EXPLANATION) based on the learner's profile, snapshot, and recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: EXAM_PREPARATION when any recommendation has action_type EXAM_PRACTICE
Priority order: misconception > confidence > recovery > exam > default

userStories.title: TutorContextAdapter: orchestrator that builds the full context
userStories.description: As a developer, I want TutorContextAdapter that calls SnapshotService, LearnerProfileBuilder, RecommendationService, and AdaptiveStrategySelector, and formats the result into a single system prompt block.
acceptanceCriteria: build() calls get_snapshot, build_profile, get_recommendations, and select
format_context_block() includes profile_block as the base
format_context_block() appends ## Learning Recommendations section when recommendations exist
format_context_block() appends ## Teaching Strategy section when strategy is non-empty and known
format_context_block() includes all 3 sections when all data present

userStories.title: Wire TutorContextAdapter into all entry points
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all 3 entry points (graph endpoint, chat endpoint, Telegram bot) to use TutorContextAdapter instead of the inline SnapshotService + LearnerProfileBuilder pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /graph/chat uses context_adapter.build() instead of snapshot_service + profile_builder
POST /chat uses context_adapter.build() instead of snapshot_service + profile_builder
Telegram bot _build_learner_profile uses context_adapter.build() instead of snapshot_service + profile_builder
All exceptions are caught with logger.warning fallback to empty string
